summary: Detailed implementation plan for creating two sets (A & B) of the Class XII Mathematics Half-Yearly Examination paper with marking schemes. Identifies issues in the original paper (wrong mark distribution, deleted-topic violations), proposes corrected structure matching the required chapter-wise marks (R&F: 8, Inv Trig: 8, Matrices: 10, Determinants: 10, C&D: 14, AppD: 14, Integrals: 16), and lists all proposed questions for both sets with difficulty levels (HOT/MOT/LOT).
